button-swap.title: Welcome page button
button-swap.for: A page whose button changes: the Welcome page's banner, a button in an empty view.

events.swap: the label rolls from the old one to the new one

before.text: Try out the new Agents window

app-badge.title: Dock badge
app-badge.for: The app icon in the Mac's Dock with a count badge (sessions waiting, attention counts).

events.badge: the badge pops in (then counts up once)

list-actions.title: Row actions
list-actions.for: A row whose actions change: a new hover action, a moved button, with its tooltip, clicked.

events.hover: the pointer reaches the row's action

picker.title: Picker
picker.for: A picker in the chat input (models, modes; with of: agent, the agent picker): its entries, the current one checked; with loads, a picker that's back; with details, a model's Details (its settings as segmented controls), an option picked.

events.details: with details: the current model's Details replace the list
events.pick: with details: the option of the section with pick is clicked

queued-message.title: Queued message
queued-message.for: A message queued while the agent works: removed (or sent, edited), and what the agent does then.

example.message: Also add a test for the empty state

sessions-find.title: Find a session
sessions-find.for: Finding in the Sessions list: Find opens, the query is typed, the list filters to the match, and it opens.

events.typed: the typing ends and the list filters

sessions.title: Fix flaky terminal tests
sessions.prompt: Find out why the terminal tests are flaky and fix them.

sessions.title: Welcome page sign-in
sessions.prompt: Offer GitHub sign-in on the Welcome page when signed out.

slash-menu.title: Slash command
slash-menu.for: A slash command in the chat input and its suggestions: a new command, a new form of one.

events.select: the selection moves to the new entry

entries.label: /fork
entries.description: Fork the conversation into a new session

entries.label: /fork prompt <prompt>
entries.description: Fork it and send a prompt

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.for: A modal dialog: a confirmation, a warning, a permission prompt, a setup's steps (rows). Its new sentence lights; its primary button is clicked.

events.click: the primary button is pressed and the dialog closes (only on its word: without one, the pointer rests on the button)
events.act: with rows: the current row's primary action is clicked (the dialog stays)

example.title: Install the plugin "Release Notes" from the marketplace?
example.detail: It was requested by a link. **Plugins can run code on your machine.**

setting.title: Setting
setting.for: A setting: a default the PR changes (before → after, flipping by itself), a new setting, a new description; with window: agents, the Agents window's Settings modal.

events.flip: the value changes to the new default

example.description: Show the GitHub sign-in button on the Welcome page when you are signed out.

command-palette.title: Command Palette
command-palette.for: A new or renamed command, or a new keybinding: typed in the Command Palette, the new one selected.

events.select: the selection moves to the new command

notification.title: Notification
notification.for: A notification toast: a new or changed message, new actions.

events.click: its first action is pressed and the toast goes (only on its word: without one, the pointer rests on it)

example.message: A new version of the extension is available. Restart the extension host to use it.

editor.title: Editor
editor.for: Text appearing at the cursor (pasted, inserted by a command): the PR's own example.

example.insert:
- Announce it in the team channel
- Close the milestone

card.title: Card
card.for: No UI to show (a default behind the scenes, a fix that leaves the UI as it was): the change in words, as release notes.

events.show: its lines appear, one by one

lines.text: Files are indexed in the background

policy.title: Policy
policy.for: A setting your organization manages (an enterprise policy): VS Code's indicator, and its hover.

events.hover: the pointer reaches the indicator and its hover opens

example.description: Enable agent mode for chat. When enabled, agent mode can be activated via the dropdown in the view.

windows.title: Windows
windows.for: VS Code on Windows (another OS): its taskbar tile's badge, its jump list; or a terminal whose app's window (a sign-in) opens in front of VS Code.

events.prompt: with prompt: the terminal app's window opens in front of VS Code

web.title: VS Code for the Web
web.for: VS Code in a browser (another platform): vscode.dev, a tunnel, what the page shows once connected.

events.connect: it connects: the remote indicator says where

system-notification.title: System notification
system-notification.for: A notification from the OS, outside VS Code's window (a session needs your input while you're elsewhere).

events.click: its action is clicked and the banner goes (only on its word: without one, the pointer rests on it)

example.message: A session needs your input: "Add an empty state"

sign-in.title: Sign-in
sign-in.for: A sign-in the build can't do on camera, told in the Accounts menu: its sign-in entry, picked, then signed in.

events.pick: the sign-in entry is picked: signed in

example.item: Sign in with GitHub to use GitHub Copilot

extension.title: Extension
extension.for: An extension (the Marketplace, the network): searched for, its page, verified publisher, installed.

example.name: Release Notes Helper
example.description: Write release notes from your merged pull requests.

remote.title: Remote
remote.for: A remote window (SSH, a tunnel, a container): the remote indicator's options, one picked, connected.

events.connect: the option is picked and the window connects (only on its word: without one, the selection rests on it)

tool-approval.title: Tool approval
tool-approval.for: The agent asking before it runs something (a model and credits): its question, Allow's options, the result.

debug.title: Debugger
debug.for: Debugging (a runtime): paused at a breakpoint, Variables, a step with its value inline.

update.title: Update
update.for: An update (Stable's update channel): the Manage gear's badge, Restart to Update, the release notes.

events.restart: Restart to Update is clicked and the release notes open (only on its word: without one, the pointer rests on it)

notes: Chat: fork a conversation with a title
Settings: a policy indicator you can hover

sessions-organize.title: Organize sessions
sessions-organize.for: An agent organizing the Sessions list: its tool lines in chat, then sessions pinned and archived in the list.

sessions-rename.title: Rename a group
sessions-rename.for: A Sessions group renamed in place: the new name typed in its rename box, the list refreshing under it while the draft stays.

events.refresh: the list refreshes (a session arrives): the draft stays

remote-environments.title: Remote Environments
remote-environments.for: The Agents window's Remote Environments (the network, a sign-in): a group's refresh ends in a prompt with its action link, clicked; with rows, a group's remotes, a row's actions on hover, and what its Delete asks.

events.show: the group's refresh ends and its prompt shows
events.click: the action link is clicked: a spinner beside it (only on its word: without one, the pointer rests on it); with rows, Delete is clicked and its confirmation opens
events.hover: with rows: the pointer reaches the row and its actions show

example.label: Sign in to allow access to your tunnels.

above.label: SSH
above.description: Use the SSH settings action to add a host.

connector.title: Connector
connector.for: A Copilot connector's page in Customizations > Browse (an authorization on the account): Connect turns into the disabled Connecting... with Cancel beside it; Cancel is clicked, and Connect is back.

events.connect: Connect is clicked: Connecting... (disabled) and Cancel show
events.cancel: Cancel is clicked: Connect is back

example.name: Release Notes Feed
example.description: Read and search the release notes of your projects.

artifact-group.title: Artifact group
artifact-group.for: A chat's artifacts of one integration in one pill above the chat input (several pull requests): the pill, its dropdown opened, a row's actions on hover.

events.open: the pill is clicked: its dropdown opens
events.hover: the pointer reaches the first row: its actions show
